note: Machine-readable form of kb/vmem_rule.md with kb/vmem_rule_v2_additions.md and kb/vmem_rule_v3_changes.md. Identity, target, class, action and aliases only: no doses, concentrations or exposure regimes. vmem is 'depolarize', 'hyperpolarize' or null; null is the only non-direction. Agent-level 'vmem' overrides the class rule and is present only where it changes the value the class rule would give: an agent whose own mechanism contradicts its class default, or a construct whose functional action (e.g. a dominant-negative subunit = knockdown) differs from the delivery action an extractor records (overexpress), which an extractor may have typed instead; harness/derive_features.py now prefers the action in this file when picking the class rule, so these pins agree with their class rule and are kept as an explicit record of the intended value. v3: adds the setup-pass gap agents of kb/lookup_gaps_v3.json, adds the classes non_electrical and other_transporter, and corrects the v2 entries listed in kb/vmem_rule_v3_changes.md. Whole-string 'plus' arms and strings a splitter cannot split (e.g. 'cavb1+cavb2 rnai') are entered as single combination agents with a 'components' list.
